messages:
Priya (Finance): Heads-up — DeltaHealth just pinged support about invoice INV-2026-0427. They say the platform subscription appears twice for March (migration month). Copy of the relevant lines below.

Priya (Finance): ```
Invoice: INV-2026-0427
Customer: DeltaHealth
Period: 2026-03-01 - 2026-03-31
Lines:
- DEDICATED_CAP_001  Reserved GPU capacity (monthly)      $12,000
- PLATFORM_SUBSCRIPTION      Platform subscription (monthly) $3,000
- PLATFORM_SUBSCRIPTION      Platform subscription (migration) $3,000
- SUPPORT_TIER_STANDARD     Support - standard              $1,200
Total: $19,200
```

Kevin (AM): Wait, we did a staged migration in March but I thought platform fees were prorated, not duplicated. Which system generated the extra line?

Ellie (Billing Ops): Looking into the billing run. Early findings: the migration orchestration emits an event SKU PLATFORM_MIGRATION. Our invoice-expander currently maps PLATFORM_MIGRATION -> PLATFORM_SUBSCRIPTION during line-item normalization, so the original PLATFORM_SUBSCRIPTION line and the expanded migration SKU both become PLATFORM_SUBSCRIPTION in the final invoice => duplicate charge.

Priya (Finance): Customer is unhappy and asking for immediate credit. They flagged they were on Dedicated + Platform and migrated an instance; they expected a one-time migration proration, not a full second monthly fee.

Carlos (Legal): Do we have contract language for migrations / pro rata adjustments? If so we should reference it before issuing the credit. If not, we can approve a one-off good-will credit but document it.

Ellie (Billing Ops): Proposed fix: 1) Issue a $3,000 credit (match the duplicated line) and add a billing note; 2) Patch invoice-expander mapping so PLATFORM_MIGRATION remains its own line type and is collapsed correctly into a single proration amount, not a full subscription; 3) Re-run invoice preview for Apr to ensure no carry-over. ETA for patch: EOD today.

Kevin (AM): I can tell DeltaHealth we'll issue a credit and follow up with a corrected invoice. Need finance + legal sign-off. Priya, can you draft the credit memo?

Priya (Finance): Yep — I'll draft the memo and route to Carlos for legal review. I'll mark it provisional until legal confirms wording.

Carlos (Legal): Approve provisional credit of $3,000 pending final contract check. If contract explicitly disallows credits for migrations, we escalate to leadership, but that's unlikely given our past practice.

billing-bot: Created ticket TKT-8421 referencing INV-2026-0427 and linked to billing-run 2026-03. Patch branch: billing/patch/platform-migration-dedupe-1845 created.

Ellie (Billing Ops): Patch PR opened. I'll merge once the unit test for invoice expansion passes. After merge, I'll generate a corrected invoice preview and share with Priya for the credit memo.

Priya (Finance): Customer-facing note prepared: "We identified a billing generator issue that duplicated a platform line during a migration event. We're issuing a $3,000 credit to correct this for March and you'll see an adjusted invoice within 3 business days. Apologies for the confusion." Will send after legal ok.

Kevin (AM): Thanks — please copy me on the customer message. I'll be the point for escalation. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-047 created (amount $3,000) and attached to ticket TKT-8421.

Priya (Finance): Closing loop — legal approved wording, credit memo ready, patch merged, corrected invoice preview generated. I will apply the credit and email the customer this afternoon.

Kevin (AM): Great — let me know when it's sent so I can confirm with the customer.

Ellie (Billing Ops): Logged follow-up task: BF-1785 to add a validation rule to invoice-expander to prevent mapping collision of migration SKUs.

Priya (Finance): Thanks team. I'll post the sent confirmation here when done.

Kevin (AM): Appreciate the fast triage. :clap:
